‣ Now shows summaries of Grok 4.3’s reasoning, and also lets you use Grok 4.3 without any reasoning!

long_notes:
Hey everyone! So on Friday at about 1 PM my time, xAI officially retired a whole bunch of older models, including (but not limited to) grok-4, grok-4-fast-reasoning, grok-4-fast-non-reasoning, grok-4-1-fast-reasoning, and grok-4-1-fast-non-reasoning. It is the retirement of the last two that really make me sad because of how cheap and smart they were. 

But anyway, this update removes those models from this shortcut, and also let you use Grok 4.3 in non-reasoning mode, and shows you its reasoning summaries in chats! It also replaces grok-imagine-image-pro with grok-imagine-image-quality, which is xAI's newer (and cheaper) image generation model, and has several other bug fixes and improvements. Hope you all enjoy!

P.S. I deleted Grok AI Chat (Legacy) from RoutineHub because xAI also retired all grok-3 and grok-3-mini models on Friday, so that shortcut is pretty much completely useless now. If you've downloaded Grok AI Chat Legacy before, the update I posted to it yesterday removes the retired models while still letting you view your old chats. If you have not downloaded Grok AI Chat Legacy before, then I wouldn't recommend it because there is literally no point. See ya guys!
